question.worked_solution:
The given set contains the roots $z\in C$ of some cubic polynomial $p(z).$

Since the cubic polynomial has roots ${z}_{1}=2,$ ${z}_{2}=3-\text{i},$ and ${z}_{3}=3+\text{i},$ and the coefficient of the cubic term is $a=1,$ we can write the polynomial as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}p(z) & =a(z-{z}_{1})(z-{z}_{2})(z-{z}_{3}) \\  & =(1)(z-2)(z-(3-\text{i}))(z-(3+\text{i})) \\  & =(z-2)({z}^{2}-z(3+\text{i})-z(3-\text{i})+(3-\text{i})(3+\text{i})) \\  & =(z-2)({z}^{2}-6z+10) \\  & ={z}^{3}-6{z}^{2}+10z-2{z}^{2}+12z-20 \\  & ={z}^{3}-8{z}^{2}+22z-20\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we can express the given set as

$$
{2,3-\text{i},3+\text{i}}={z\in C\,:\,{z}^{3}-8{z}^{2}+22z-20=0}.
$$
